summary: Prompt human review is supported to decide whether to offer a sensitive goals-and-priorities conversation alongside, not instead of, urgent assessment of potentially treatable symptoms. The record shows increasing fatigue and exertional breathlessness with recurrent chest tightness, plus worsening platelet counts and a recent lower eGFR. However, no diagnosis explaining this trajectory, functional baseline, residence, medication list, admissions history, or active advance-care plan is documented, so the scope and timing of any conversation require clinician judgement.
